title: Murder at the Townhouse Café
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0992.txt (420 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Inspector Megure, Detective Takagi, Detective Chiba) omitted by convention. case_type: attempted_murder (the victim, Tomita, survives the attack -- confirmed on-screen: 'Apparently the manager's all right.'). Correction vs. the old low-fidelity file: the old file's stated culprit (Sakai Chitose) is confirmed correct by the transcript, but its motive was wrong -- it claimed Sakai 'develops feelings for Tomita' (a romantic-rejection motive that never appears anywhere in the transcript). The actual, on-screen motive is professional/creative resentment: Sakai says outright 'I came up with the menu, the concept, and the eye-catching yard. But he kept me working part-time. He didn't give me anything.' No romantic angle is stated or implied. The old file was also missing essentially all mechanics of the case (the laxative slipped to Nonaka to force him from his seat, the stolen gloves planted to frame him, the yard-camouflage route used to fake an alibi, the torn-cloth/nail forensic evidence, the donut-timer alibi window, and the unrelated Furukawa dine-and-dash red herring) -- all reconstructed here from the full transcript.
